name: The Influencer
description: A complete stream, record, edit, reformat, caption, and publish kit, plus a Creator sidebar and right-click video tools.

items.name: creator-deck
items.summary: A creator cockpit in the left sidebar: go live, set aspect, reformat, caption, jump to clips.

items.name: video-reformat
items.summary: Right-click video reformat, transcode, compress, caption-prep, and thumbnail tools.

items.name: obs-studio
items.summary: Streaming and recording studio with native PipeWire screen and app audio capture.

items.name: obs-vkcapture
items.summary: Vulkan and OpenGL game capture for OBS on Wayland.

items.name: obs-backgroundremoval
items.summary: AI webcam background removal for OBS, no green screen needed.

items.name: obs-pipewire-audio-capture
items.summary: Per-application audio capture for OBS (capture one app's sound).

items.name: v4l2loopback-dkms
items.summary: Virtual camera kernel module that powers the OBS Virtual Camera.

items.name: linux-headers
items.summary: Kernel headers so DKMS can build v4l2loopback (use linux-cachyos-headers on the CachyOS kernel).

items.name: gpu-screen-recorder
items.summary: ShadowPlay-style GPU-encoded recorder and replay buffer; the Creator Deck's recorder.

items.name: wf-recorder
items.summary: Lightweight wlroots-native screen recorder.

items.name: kdenlive
items.summary: Multitrack non-linear video editor with effects, transitions, and keyframes.

items.name: losslesscut-bin
items.summary: Fast lossless trimming, cutting, and merging of video and audio.

items.name: easyeffects
items.summary: Real-time PipeWire microphone and audio effects chain, system-wide.

items.name: noise-suppression-for-voice
items.summary: RNNoise neural noise suppression (LADSPA/LV2) for EasyEffects, OBS, and Ardour.

items.name: audacity
items.summary: Multitrack audio recorder and editor for voiceovers and podcasts.

items.name: gimp
items.summary: Raster image editor for thumbnails, compositing, and retouching.

items.name: inkscape
items.summary: Vector editor for crisp thumbnail text, logos, and overlay assets.

items.name: krita
items.summary: Digital painting for illustrated thumbnails and channel art.

items.name: yt-dlp
items.summary: Download reference footage and your own back-catalogue; extract audio.

items.name: handbrake
items.summary: GUI and CLI batch transcoder with presets for each platform.

items.name: whisper.cpp
items.summary: Local speech-to-text for auto-captioning (the Creator Deck's caption action).

items.name: capture-website-cli
items.summary: Renders a URL or HTML file to an image for scripted thumbnails.

items.name: youtubeuploader
items.summary: Scripted YouTube uploads from the command line with metadata.

items.name: davinci-resolve
items.summary: Pro NLE and color grading. Proprietary: you download the installer from Blackmagic, then this builds it. Free build on Linux cannot import H.264/H.265; use the DaVinci reformat action.

items.name: reaper
items.summary: Pro DAW with a native Linux build (paid after a 60-day evaluation).

items.name: wl-screenrec
items.summary: High-performance hardware-encoded wlroots screen recorder.

items.name: distroav
items.summary: NDI in and out for OBS (multi-PC and multi-app video over the LAN).

items.name: owncast-bin
items.summary: Self-hosted live streaming server (your own Twitch alternative).

items.name: shotcut
items.summary: Simple cross-platform MLT video editor, approachable for newcomers.

items.name: blender
items.summary: 3D suite with a Video Sequence Editor and compositor for intros and motion graphics.

items.name: darktable
items.summary: RAW photo developer for high-quality still and thumbnail source shots.

items.name: upscayl-bin
items.summary: AI image upscaler (Real-ESRGAN) to rescue low-res thumbnail assets.

items.name: qprompt
items.summary: Modern teleprompter for scripted delivery.

items.name: subtitleedit
items.summary: GUI subtitle editor with built-in whisper.cpp transcription and styling.
